callScript:
Hi Cafe Buddy's Espresso team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (Gola Road branch) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua? 

Actually, maine dekha ki aapki purani website offline thi (404 error), toh humne ek fast, mobile-friendly modern website design ready ki hai jisme direct WhatsApp ordering aur menu showcase hai. 

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar pasand aaye, to hum ise aapki exact branding aur live menu ke sath fully functional bana sakte hain. Batayein, when are you free for a quick walkthrough?
